name: yolo
description: Agent skills for Ultralytics YOLO and Platform: model selection, dataset annotation, training, tuning, inference, export, and deployment through the web UI, Python package, yolo CLI, and ul Platform CLI.

interface.longDescription: Skills covering the full Ultralytics computer-vision lifecycle through Platform and local code: dataset upload, annotation, and validation; model selection; cloud or local training; tuning; inference and tracking; dedicated endpoints; Solutions; export to ONNX, TensorRT, CoreML, Core AI, OpenVINO, and NPU formats; and scripted Platform API operations through the ul CLI.
